{{Top|leg}}
A '''crash helmet''' or '''racing helmet'''<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> was a safety device worn on an individual's head to protect them from injury in the event of a vehicle crash. The [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[T'achak T'andar]] always wore a crash helmet when operating ground vehicles at fast speeds.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
